detailTitle: Job Analyser - AI-Powered Career Analysis Tool
title: Job Analyser
description: Intelligent job description analysis tool that uses natural language processing to extract key requirements, skills, and qualifications. Helps job seekers better understand what employers are looking for and match their profiles accordingly.
longDescription: A comprehensive job analysis platform that leverages advanced NLP techniques to parse and analyze job descriptions from various sources. The application extracts meaningful insights about skill requirements, experience levels, salary ranges, and company culture indicators. Features include skill gap analysis, personalized recommendations, and learning path suggestions to help job seekers improve their profiles and increase their chances of landing their dream job.
achievements: Built advanced NLP pipeline for job description analysis
Implemented skill extraction and matching algorithms
Created personalized recommendation system
Developed comprehensive web interface for job seekers

title: Smart Minutes
description: Developed a full-stack meeting assistant application with Google Calendar and Firebase Auth integration, featuring live transcription and AI-powered summarization capabilities.
longDescription: A comprehensive smart meeting assistant that revolutionizes how users manage and interact with their meetings. The application integrates seamlessly with Google Calendar and uses advanced AI technologies for real-time transcription and intelligent summarization. Built with modern web technologies and deployed for scalable performance.
achievements: Implemented live transcription using WebRTC and OpenAI Whisper
Built real-time transcript search and summarization using GPT-3.5
Integrated Google Calendar and Firebase Authentication
Processed 30-second audio chunks for optimal performance

title: TradeNet – Distributed Stock Trading Engine
description: Designed a multithreaded stock trading platform using RPC to handle concurrent client-server operations with advanced caching, replication, and fault tolerance mechanisms.
longDescription: A high-performance distributed stock trading engine built to handle real-time trading operations at scale. The system implements advanced distributed systems concepts including caching, replication, and fault tolerance to ensure reliability and performance. Deployed on AWS with containerization for maximum scalability.
achievements: Boosted performance by 30% through optimized caching strategies
Reduced latency by 40% with efficient RPC implementation
Achieved 99.9% uptime with fault-tolerant architecture
Deployed scalable distributed setup on AWS with Docker and K3s

detailTitle: Travel Planner - Full-Stack Trip Planning Application
title: Travel Planner
description: Created a responsive React frontend with comprehensive trip planning features, backed by robust Spring Boot APIs integrated with MongoDB for secure data handling and storage.
longDescription: A full-stack travel planning application that simplifies the process of organizing trips. The application features a modern, responsive React frontend with over 10 user-friendly features, complemented by a robust Spring Boot backend with secure API endpoints and efficient MongoDB data management.
achievements: Built responsive React frontend with 10+ planning features
Designed 12+ Spring Boot APIs with MongoDB integration
Implemented secure data handling and storage mechanisms
Enhanced user experience for comprehensive trip planning

title: UMate - Roommate Finder
description: Engineered a React + Flask web application with comprehensive APIs for onboarding, authentication, and profile matching, featuring advanced MongoDB data modeling and AWS S3 integration.
longDescription: A sophisticated roommate matching platform designed specifically for university students. The application uses intelligent algorithms to match compatible roommates based on lifestyle preferences, study habits, and personal traits. Features comprehensive user onboarding, secure authentication, and cloud-based image storage.
achievements: Built React + Flask web app with 10+ comprehensive APIs
Modeled MongoDB with nested schemas and optimized indexed fields
Integrated AWS S3 for secure and scalable image storage
Implemented advanced profile matching algorithms
